title: Transport of normalized regular-module evaluation along one geometric map
statement: Let E be a totally disconnected normed field, p:V to X a scheme morphism and a:Spec Omega to V a geometric map with Omega algebraically closed. Let H be any functor on modules over the condensed E coefficient ring of Spec Omega having the regular-module normalization CondensedFieldPointScalarProperty at z. Define F by restriction along the inverse canonical coefficient isomorphism for p, module pullback along a, then H. There is an E-linear coordinate b on F of the regular pulled-back coefficient module. For every endomorphism f, its scalar in these coordinates equals the value at a(z) of its continuous coefficient under condensedFieldPullbackRealization E p.

proof.text: Transport the normalized H-coordinate along condensedFieldGeometricRegularIso with condensedField_coordinates_of_conjugacy. Apply the geometric regular coefficient compatibility identity to compute the conjugated scalar.

proof_origin.note: B4: coordinate transport proved from the strictly smaller geometric regular coefficient compatibility statement; one scalar step remains split off.

theorem condensedField_geometric_evaluation_scalars
    (E : Type u) [NormedField E] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace E]
    (X V : Scheme.{u}) (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (p : V ⟶ X) (a : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ V) (z : Spec (.of Ω))
    (H : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Spec (.of Ω))) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj E) (Spec (.of Ω))) ⥤
      ModuleCat.{u + 1} E)
    (hH : CondensedFieldPointScalarProperty E Ω z H) :
    let R := condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj E) X
    let Ri := (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} p).obj R
    let F :=
      condensedFieldGeometricModulePullback (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj E) p a ⋙ H
    ∃ b : F.obj (Mod.regular Ri) ≃ₗ[E] E,
      ∀ f : Mod.regular Ri ⟶ Mod.regular Ri,
        b (F.map f (b.symm 1)) =
          (((inv (condensedFieldPullbackRealization E p) ≫ f.hom ≫
          condensedFieldPullbackRealization E p).hom.app
            (Opposite.op (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 V)))) (ULift.up 1)).down (a z)
